correctness.rationale: A complete center-code leaf-extension generation enumerates all 1–8 vertex tree types, and all 29 degree-matched pair differences were computed exactly. Every nonexception pair has coefficientwise one-sign isolate-free polynomial difference. The unique exception has difference t^5-t^7, yielding the displayed p-rational threshold at p=1/2; independent rooted-tree DP reproduces every polynomial. The conditional denominator is positive and the expected-isolation identity follows from independent site retention. No larger-tree statement is asserted.

value.rationale: Degree summaries and expected isolate counts are standard coarse habitat descriptions; the conditional probability that every nonempty surviving patch has a surviving neighbor is a distinct natural all-network isolation-risk criterion. The exact smallest-order obstruction, unique minimal class and sign-reversal probability quantify when degree-only comparisons cease to be reliable. This is a motivated exact finite boundary, not arbitrary parameter selection or a computational exercise.
